goal: World events: play until world events are offered, take different choices, and judge whether the consequences are clear and fair.

findings.title: First world event can't be reached in a 30-minute session: it is scheduled 420-660 game s in, and the game ran at 6-15 tps
findings.detail: I played normally (5 objectives, nation, settlement, stall), then let time pass. After about 26 wall minutes the game was at tick 13928 (~279 game seconds). WorldEvents.cs schedules the first player event at FIRST_PLAYER_EVENT_MIN_SECONDS=420 (tick 21000+). Nation events start at 240 s or later (tick 12000+), and none had shown up in the chronicle by tick 13928. state.worldEvent was null the whole session. At the load this box was under (load average ~80-100, tps 5.5-15.9), seeing an event takes about an hour of wall time. Expected: a playtest session with this goal can reach an event, either with a shorter first-event delay, a staged-event switch the brief allows, or a save where an event is pending.
findings.repro: pt start --profile beyond-nations --game-dir /root/bn-wt-playtest064 --seed 108; play through objectives 1-6; pt wait in 45 s chunks until about 26 min wall; pt state shows worldEvent null at tick 13928

findings.title: Nothing on screen tells the player that world events exist or when one might come
findings.detail: In ~279 game seconds, no HUD element, tip or objective mentioned world events. The chronicle showed rivalries, alliances, caravans and new nations, but nothing marked as a world event. A player who has heard about events has no idea whether they are close or what triggers them. Expected: a tip or chronicle line foreshadowing events, e.g. once the player leads a nation.
findings.repro: same as above; read the tips and the chronicle panel

findings.title: Huge world-space settlement label is clipped across the top of the screen when inside your own settlement
findings.detail: After founding and entering the settlement, giant text ('...0 here, 3/8 residents') runs across the top of the screen behind the HUD panels. It is cut off and can't be read.
findings.repro: found a settlement (N, 50 wood, F), press E to enter; look at the top of the screen

verdict: The world events could not be judged: the first one is scheduled at least 420 game seconds in, and at 6-15 tps the session ended at ~279 game seconds with none offered and no nation event in the chronicle. The early game felt good. Objectives chain cleanly, the 'too close, open ground lies 80 to the south-west' message is excellent, and the chronicle feels alive with rivalries and caravans. Testing this goal needs either a faster-loading start or permission to stage an event.
